title: Extract normalized sender identities
objective: Repair extract_sender_identity so it derives canonical sender-related identities from the fixed provider-neutral message fixtures. Parse mailbox fields rather than copying display-name strings, normalize mailbox addresses/domains to lowercase, normalize List-ID to its identifier, and preserve missing optional identities as null. Do not change the test.
acceptance_criteria: From is parsed into a lowercase mailbox address and domain without retaining the display name
Reply-To and Return-Path are parsed into lowercase mailbox addresses and domains when present
List-ID is normalized to its lowercase identifier without inventing an additional domain relationship
missing optional Reply-To, Return-Path, and List-ID values remain null instead of being guessed
the fixed acceptance test passes without modification
